name: hoomd-dlext

about.description:
Provides access to HOOMD-blue simulation data on CPU or GPU via DLPack.
This project is primarily designed to enable access to HOOMD-blue for
the PySAGES project. The package is built against representative
HOOMD-blue releases from the v2 through v7 series.
about.summary: Wrapper for HOOMD-blue simulation data into DLPack data structures.

raw_meta_yaml:
{% set version = "0.6.0" %}
{% set cuda_major = (cuda_compiler_version | default("0.0", true)).split(".")[0] | int %}
{% set variant = hoomd ~ "_" ~ ("cuda" ~ cuda_major ~ "_" if cuda_major != 0 else "") %}

package:
  name: hoomd-dlext
  version: {{ version }}

source:
  url: https://github.com/SSAGESLabs/hoomd-dlext/archive/refs/tags/v{{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: e91f0317e53e683746db38640de6a5daa3b1fd5beb84ff96a01e1a81169c58ff

build:
  number: 0
  # Upstream package does not support Windows, Python < 3.6, or PyPy
  skip: true  # [win or py<36 or python_impl == "pypy" or (hoomd == "v2" and py != 310) or (hoomd != "v2" and py != 311) or (hoomd in ("v2", "v3") and cuda_compiler_version != "None")]
  string: {{ variant }}py{{ py }}_h{{ PKG_HASH }}_{{ PKG_BUILDNUM }}
  script_env:
    - CUDA_MAJOR={{ cuda_major }}
    - HOOMD_TAG={{ hoomd }}
    - SETUPTOOLS_SCM_PRETEND_VERSION={{ version }}
  ignore_run_exports_from:
    - tbb-devel

requirements:
  build:
    - {{ compiler('cxx') }}   # [hoomd not in ("v3", "v4", "v5")]
    - {{ stdlib("c") }}       # [hoomd not in ("v3", "v4", "v5")]
    - cxx-compiler 1.5.2      # [hoomd == "v3"]
    - cxx-compiler 1.8.0      # [hoomd in ("v4", "v5")]
    - {{ compiler('cuda') }}  # [linux64 and cuda_compiler_version != "None"]
    - libcxx-devel 16.0.6.*   # [osx and hoomd == "v3"]
    - cmake >=3.16,!=3.23.0
    - make

  host:
    - python
    - pybind11 <3  # [hoomd in ("v2", "v3", "v4", "v5")]
    - pybind11     # [hoomd in ("v6", "v7")]
    - pybind11-abi
    - dlpack >=0.5
    - eigen <5             # [hoomd in ("v3", "v4", "v5", "v6")]
    - eigen                # [hoomd == "v7"]
    - hoomd ==2.9.7 cpu_*  # [hoomd == "v2"]
    - hoomd ==3.11.0       # [hoomd == "v3"]
    - hoomd ==4.9.1        # [hoomd == "v4"]
    - hoomd ==5.0.0        # [hoomd == "v5"]
    - hoomd ==6.1.1        # [hoomd == "v6"]
    - hoomd ==7.0.1        # [hoomd == "v7"]
    - setuptools-scm
    - tbb-devel <2022  # [hoomd == "v3"]
    - tbb-devel        # [hoomd != "v3"]
    # CUDA dependencies (we don't really need all of them, but HOOMD checks that they are present)
    - cuda-version {{ cuda_compiler_version }}  # [linux64 and cuda_compiler_version != "None"]
    - cuda-cudart-dev    # [linux64 and cuda_compiler_version != "None"]
    - cuda-driver-dev    # [linux64 and cuda_compiler_version != "None"]
    - cuda-nvrtc-dev     # [linux64 and cuda_compiler_version != "None"]
    - cuda-profiler-api  # [linux64 and cuda_compiler_version != "None"]
    - libcublas-dev      # [linux64 and cuda_compiler_version != "None"]
    - libcufft-dev       # [linux64 and cuda_compiler_version != "None"]
    - libcusolver-dev    # [linux64 and cuda_compiler_version != "None"]
    - libcusparse-dev    # [linux64 and cuda_compiler_version != "None"]

  run:
    - python
    - {{ pin_compatible('hoomd', max_pin='x.x') }}

test:
  imports:
    # Build systems lack a working libcuda.so.1, cannot test GPU builds, even on the CPU.
    - hoomd.dlext  # [cuda_compiler_version == "None"]

about:
  home: https://github.com/SSAGESLabs/hoomd-dlext
  license: MIT
  license_family: MIT
  license_file: LICENSE.md
  summary: Wrapper for HOOMD-blue simulation data into DLPack data structures.

  description: |
    Provides access to HOOMD-blue simulation data on CPU or GPU via DLPack.
    This project is primarily designed to enable access to HOOMD-blue for
    the PySAGES project. The package is built against representative
    HOOMD-blue releases from the v2 through v7 series.

  doc_url: https://github.com/SSAGESLabs/hoomd-dlext
  dev_url: https://github.com/SSAGESLabs/hoomd-dlext

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - p-zubieta
    - nrouizem
